reason: Both plans hit every hard requirement, but Response A's step 2 has the migration tool install/configure logical replication (touching production replication slots/config) before the full backup in step 3, undercutting its own stated intent and the requirement that backup precede any production-modifying action; Response B orders backup (step 3) strictly before the dry run and before establishing replication (step 5), which is the more correct and internally consistent sequence.
